preconditions.description: The length of the string s is between 1 and 100,000 inclusive.
The string s consists of lowercase English letters and its length is exactly n.
The length of the string t is between 1 and n inclusive.
The string t consists of lowercase English letters and its length is exactly m.
The maximum number of pieces x is between 1 and 30 inclusive.

postconditions.expression: stdout == 'YES' if f(s, t) <= x else stdout == 'NO'
postconditions.description: The output is 'YES' if the minimal number of substrings f(s, t) is less than or equal to x, otherwise 'NO'.
